import cadquery as cq
# Generating a workplane for sketch 0
wp_sketch0 = cq.Workplane(cq.Plane(cq.Vector(-0.75, 0.0, -0.2265625), cq.Vector(1.0, 6.123233995736766e-17, -6.123233995736766e-17), cq.Vector(6.123233995736766e-17, -1.0, 6.123233995736766e-17)))
loop0=wp_sketch0.moveTo(0.2390625, 0.0).lineTo(0.2390625, 0.11953125).lineTo(0.0, 0.11953125).lineTo(0.0, 0.0).close()
solid0=wp_sketch0.add(loop0).extrude(0.203125, both=True)
solid=solid0
# Generating a workplane for sketch 1
wp_sketch1 = cq.Workplane(cq.Plane(cq.Vector(-0.5109375, 0.0, -0.2265625), cq.Vector(1.0, 6.123233995736766e-17, -6.123233995736766e-17), cq.Vector(6.123233995736766e-17, -1.0, 6.123233995736766e-17)))
loop1=wp_sketch1.moveTo(0.478125, 0.0).lineTo(0.478125, 0.11990131578947369).lineTo(0.0, 0.11990131578947369).lineTo(0.0, 0.0).close()
solid1=wp_sketch1.add(loop1).extrude(0.203125, both=True)
solid=solid.union(solid1)
# Generating a workplane for sketch 2
wp_sketch2 = cq.Workplane(cq.Plane(cq.Vector(-0.0390625, 0.0, -0.2265625), cq.Vector(1.0, 6.123233995736766e-17, -6.123233995736766e-17), cq.Vector(6.123233995736766e-17, -1.0, 6.123233995736766e-17)))
loop2=wp_sketch2.moveTo(0.2390625, 0.0).lineTo(0.2390625, 0.11953125).lineTo(0.0, 0.11953125).lineTo(0.0, 0.0).close()
solid2=wp_sketch2.add(loop2).extrude(0.203125, both=True)
solid=solid.union(solid2)
# Generating a workplane for sketch 3
wp_sketch3 = cq.Workplane(cq.Plane(cq.Vector(-0.5109375, 0.0, -0.109375), cq.Vector(1.0, 6.123233995736766e-17, -6.123233995736766e-17), cq.Vector(6.123233995736766e-17, -1.0, 6.123233995736766e-17)))
loop3=wp_sketch3.moveTo(0.48157894736842105, 0.0).lineTo(0.48157894736842105, 0.2131578947368421).threePointArc((0.24078947368421053, 0.45394736842105265), (0.0, 0.2131578947368421)).lineTo(0.0, 0.0).close()
loop4=wp_sketch3.moveTo(0.24078947368421053, 0.2131578947368421).circle(0.12631578947368421)
solid3=wp_sketch3.add(loop3).add(loop4).extrude(0.203125, both=True)
solid=solid.union(solid3)
# Generating a workplane for sketch 4
wp_sketch4 = cq.Workplane(cq.Plane(cq.Vector(-0.7109375, 0.0, 0.0), cq.Vector(1.0, 0.0, 0.0), cq.Vector(0.0, 0.0, 1.0)))
loop5=wp_sketch4.moveTo(0.039473684210526314, 0.0).circle(0.03865131578947368)
solid4=wp_sketch4.add(loop5).extrude(-0.203125)
solid=solid.cut(solid4)
# Generating a workplane for sketch 5
wp_sketch5 = cq.Workplane(cq.Plane(cq.Vector(-0.0390625, 0.0, 0.0), cq.Vector(1.0, 0.0, 0.0), cq.Vector(0.0, 0.0, 1.0)))
loop6=wp_sketch5.moveTo(0.039473684210526314, 0.0).circle(0.039473684210526314)
solid5=wp_sketch5.add(loop6).extrude(-0.203125)
solid=solid.cut(solid5)
# Generating a workplane for sketch 6
wp_sketch6 = cq.Workplane(cq.Plane(cq.Vector(-0.203125, 0.0, 0.0), cq.Vector(1.0, 0.0, 0.0), cq.Vector(0.0, 0.0, 1.0)))
loop7=wp_sketch6.moveTo(0.015789473684210527, 0.0).circle(0.015789473684210527)
solid6=wp_sketch6.add(loop7).extrude(-0.203125)
solid=solid.cut(solid6)
